answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. Each agent locks a 50 POA bond that loses 5% each epoch unless renewed by verified work: idle identities erode, like a glacier wearing down quartz, and cannot be stockpiled. An identity that only offers an echo of past work earns nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA up front plus decay, while one honest agent pays one 50 POA bond and renews it from earnings, keeping rewards undiluted.
